info.title: MyEfVibe — EF Core LINQ REPL
info.description: Interactive global .NET tool (efvibe) to run LINQ against an external project's EF Core DbContext with SQL, query plans, and session analytics.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Interactive EF Core LINQ shell against another project's DbContext.

options.name: -w
options.description: Session directory for exports and other artifacts (created if missing). Default: ~/.efvibe on macOS/Linux, %APPDATA%/efvibe on Windows.

options.name: -p
options.description: EF Core project to build (`.csproj` with the DbContext).

options.name: -s
options.description: Startup project for configuration (user secrets, appsettings). Auto-inferred from project references when omitted.

options.name: -c
options.description: DbContext type name (e.g. MyDbContext) or fully qualified name when multiple contexts are present.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Connection string used when constructing `DbContextOptions<TContext>` manually.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Database provider key used with `--connection-string`: sqlserver | npgsql | sqlite | oracle | mysql | mariadb.

options.name: -e
options.description: Run a single expression and exit (non-interactive).

options.name: --dblog
options.description: Enable EF database command logging (default: on; toggle in REPL with :dblog).

options.name: --dblog-level
options.description: Database log level: trace | debug | information | warning | error | critical | none.

options.name: --dblog-verbose
options.description: Show full EF diagnostic logs (default: sql-only executed commands).

options.name: --about-json
options.description: Write session metadata as JSON to stdout and exit (no REPL).

options.name: -f
options.description: Target framework moniker for building the workspace project (for example net8.0). Defaults to a framework listed in the project file, not the efvibe tool runtime.

arguments.name: EXPRESSION
arguments.description: Optional one-shot expression when `-e` is omitted but arguments are provided.
